input.sha256_scope: Concatenation of the thirty-four raw C-order input byte arrays in capture document order.
input.provenance: Self-authored in-memory BGR uint8 values emitted by tools/capture_resize_oracle.py.

expected.sha256_scope: Concatenation of the thirty-four raw C-order output byte arrays in capture document order.

limitations: This is an exact regression fixture only for its thirty-four self-authored BGR cases and the recorded scalar OpenCV 5.0.0 environment.
It covers INTER_LINEAR only. INTER_CUBIC, INTER_AREA, and every other interpolation remain outside this fixture.
It fixes no resize policy: which target size the detector or recognizer requests remains DET-001 and REC-001 work.
It does not establish image-decoder, colour, alpha, orientation, detector, recognizer, model, or end-to-end OCR compatibility.
